metadata.question: Did nighttime brightness over Houston decrease on May 18, 2024, compared to April 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need nighttime lights data. VIIRS DNB is the standard product for this. Use the monthly composite version (VNP46A3) since we're comparing month-to-month. 2. Masking strategy: Monthly VIIRS DNB composites are already cloud-masked and filtered. No additional masking needed. 3. Logic: Calculate mean nighttime lights for Houston in April 2024 and May 2024, then compare. Need to check for valid pixels and avoid C3 (null values). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time houston = ee.Geometry.Point([-95.3698, 29.7604]).buffer(20000) apr2024 = ee.DateRange('2024-04-01', '2024-04-30') may2024 = ee.DateRange('2024-05-01', '2024-05-31') # 2. Data Acquisition col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') aprIm = col.filterDate(apr2024).filterBounds(houston) mayIm = col.filterDate(may2024).filterBounds(houston) if aprIm.size().getInfo() == 0 or mayIm.size().getInfo() == 0: print("C1: One or both months have no images") print("C1") # 3. Processing aprImg = aprIm.first().select('avg_rad').multiply(ee.Image(1)) mayImg = mayIm.first().select('avg_rad').multiply(ee.Image(1)) # 4. Calculation aprMean = aprImg.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=houston, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad') mayMean = mayImg.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=houston, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad') aprv = aprMean.getInfo() mayv = mayMean.getInfo() if aprv is None or mayv is None: print("C3: One of the values is None") print("C3") print(f"April 2024: {aprv:.3f} | May 2024: {mayv:.3f} | Change: {mayv-aprv:.3f}") # 5. Answer if mayv < aprv: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
houston = ee.Geometry.Point([-95.3698, 29.7604]).buffer(20000)
apr2024 = ee.DateRange('2024-04-01', '2024-04-30')
may2024 = ee.DateRange('2024-05-01', '2024-05-31')

# 2. Data Acquisition
col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG')

aprIm = col.filterDate(apr2024).filterBounds(houston)
mayIm = col.filterDate(may2024).filterBounds(houston)

if aprIm.size().getInfo() == 0 or mayIm.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("C1: One or both months have no images")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# 3. Processing
aprImg = aprIm.first().select('avg_rad').multiply(ee.Image(1))

mayImg = mayIm.first().select('avg_rad').multiply(ee.Image(1))

# 4. Calculation  
aprMean = aprImg.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=houston, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad')
mayMean = mayImg.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=houston, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad')

aprv = aprMean.getInfo()
mayv = mayMean.getInfo()

if aprv is None or mayv is None:
    print("C3: One of the values is None")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")

print(f"April 2024: {aprv:.3f} | May 2024: {mayv:.3f} | Change: {mayv-aprv:.3f}")

# 5. Answer
if mayv < aprv:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
